meta.description: Importable starting skeleton. Webhook intake -> LLM extract (Claude) -> deterministic core (app.cli) -> error gate -> human QA. Wire your own credentials and the executeCommand path to where app/ lives. This is a scaffold, not a finished flow.

nodes.name: Deterministic Core (app.cli)
nodes.notes: Exit code is non-zero when blocking ERRORs exist. Point cwd at the repo so 'app' is importable, or use 'python3 -m app.cli /path/to/input.json'.

nodes.name: Blocking Errors?
nodes.notes: TRUE branch = clean (exit 0) -> route to human QA. FALSE branch = blocking errors -> route back for correction.

nodes.name: Human QA Queue
nodes.notes: MANDATORY GATE. Replace with your approval mechanism (email/Slack approve, n8n Wait node, or a review UI). No document leaves before a human approves.

nodes.name: Return for Correction
nodes.notes: Blocking errors present. Notify yourself with the compliance flags; fix inputs and re-run.
